column1: Note 1:NOCNG shall be used such that both cells are fully allocated and a constant total transmitted power spectral density is achieved for all OFDM symbols.Note 2:Es/Iot and NRSRP levels have been derived from other parameters for information purposes. They are not settable parameters themselves.Note 3:NB-IoT PRB location does not overlap with the PRBs allocated to the SSB of the NTN NR channel.
